sequence: Freeze fixture bytes and hash; run bounded ZIP/path/RECORD uniqueness+bidir-coverage/self-row checks.

B.name: Strict bounded immutable-byte prevalidation, then unmodified installer.install
sequence: Adapt only the narrow archive/RECORD verification core from the source-audited acquisition verifier into a new independently reviewed pure function; do not edit/re-execute consumed acquisition source.
Return a sealed ValidatedWheel token containing exact immutable raw bytes, SHA256, expected filename/name/version/dist-info and full per-member manifests only after every required check succeeds.
Construct unmodified WheelFile over a read-only, privately owned in-memory ZIP view of those exact bytes; bind stream filename to the expected .whl name and verify source identity.
Call unmodified installer.install with explicit destination settings below. No subsequent fixture path reopen, data replacement or alternate source is allowed.
required_prevalidation: Exact raw archive SHA256 and length against the frozen case manifest; no source change after validation.

Bound central directory before ZIP construction: entry counts, file/total inflation, compressed formats; reject encrypted/special/symlink/type aliases, absolute/traversal/backslash/colon/NUL/duplicate/case-fold/file-parent collisions.

Require the exact single dist-info identity, version, WHEEL1.0/py3-none-any and fixture Requires-Python; reject.data,.pth,__pycache__,native members and signature exceptions in this small fixture subset.
RECORD must have exactly three fields per row, unique exact names and exact bidirectional coverage of all non-directory archive members. Directory treatment explicit.
Every non-RECORD file must have canonical SHA256 URLsafe digest and exact decimal byte size; stream hash bytes directly without any filesystem sink.
Only the exact RECORD self-row may have empty hash/size; no other exceptions. Hash and size every member independently of installer.
Freeze per-member executable flags and expected output layout; never evaluate or import payload bytes.
B.not_skip_validation: This is complete independently reviewed content validation, not validate_contents=False or omission of verification. RouteB deliberately does not claim that library validate_record(True) ran. The later lead/auditor must explicitly accept this stronger external validation boundary before selectingB.
B.tradeoff: Avoids null writes, global overrides and package monkeypatches while reusing standard installation/script/RECORD generation. Adds one bounded validator and immutable source binding, both requiring direct adverse tests.

exact_source_API_plan.preferred_B: Use public WheelFile(ZipFile(file_like)) and unmodified installer.install. WheelSource is the documented extension abstraction but is not the first choice.
exact_source_API_plan.filename_issue: WheelFile.__init__ asserts ZipFile.filename, then parses its basename (sources.py160-173). Bare BytesIO therefore is insufficient.
exact_source_API_plan.memory_view: Plan a minimal read-only named buffer over the sealed bytes (or a privately owned NamedBytesIO with write/truncate/getbuffer disabled), with name='ssl_fixture_payload-1.0.0-py3-none-any.whl'. Standard ZipFile obtains filename from file.name. No installer class/module is patched.
exact_source_API_plan.same_bytes: The canonical bytes token remains immutable; buffer ownership stays private to the fixture source. Rehash buffer content/identity before install and after source close, and reject mutation. A read-only immutable-byte cursor is preferable if NamedBytesIO cannot provide the declared boundary; no hostile-private-state/concurrent-writer guarantee inferred.
exact_source_API_plan.fallback_WheelSource: A custom WheelSource would need dist_info_filenames/read_dist_info/get_contents and stable same-content semantics. It adds interpretation code, so defer unless the unmodified WheelFile/read-only ZIP route fails independent review.
proof_obligations: Read-only buffer compatibility with ZipFile and WheelFile on both runtimes is source-feasible, not tested.
Prove no mutable view/source reopen, correct filename/dist-info parsing, exact member-content identity and closed streams.
Do not create a new custom import/loader framework to solve a fixture-source issue.

Do not assume support for the private .bin artifact name or loader behavior. Verify the qualified standard loader against the canonical snapshot in separately released fixtures; stop on mismatch instead of renaming old evidence or adding a new loader.
